name: Hubble Space Telescope
tagline: For decades, this orbiting observatory has turned distant pinpricks of light into a universe full of stories.
imageAlt: Illustrated archive portrait of Hubble Space Telescope
credit: Original editorial illustration created for the Left Behind archive.

beats.goal: Observe the universe from above Earth’s atmosphere, producing sharp images and precise measurements across multiple wavelengths.
beats.achieved: Hubble has helped refine the expansion rate of the universe, studied galaxies and exoplanet atmospheres, and delivered iconic observations across more than three decades.
beats.ending: Hubble has not ended. Its systems and instruments have aged, and its operating mode is managed to preserve the observatory for as long as possible.
beats.now: Hubble remains in low Earth orbit and continues science operations. Its future orbital decay and end-of-life plan are separate from its current observing status.
beats.learned: The mission showed the scientific value of servicing and upgrading a space observatory, including the importance of designing for repair.
